title: Still Learning
logline: In a mask-carving workshop on the south-west coast, apprentices at every stage work beside a carver who has done it for decades, and who still calls themselves a learner.
human_question: If even the master is still learning, where does being lost end?

premise.story: The rhythm of a working carving workshop over a real commission: the youngest apprentice's mistakes, a middle apprentice given a harder face to carve, and the master deciding who is ready for what.
premise.place: A family workshop on the coast: wood shavings, paint pots, rows of half-finished faces staring from the shelves.
premise.experience: The viewer watches skill being passed on in small corrections, and feels how long it takes to see what an expert sees.

concept_links.why: The sources call everyone short of the very end a 'learner', still in training [C049-P:L55; C049-M:L11]. The workshop makes the structure visible. The source's stages are spiritual, not craft skill, and the film must not equate them.
A good guide does not give everyone the same instruction; they look closely at the person, or ask [C086-P4:L278]. The master's handing out of tasks is an everyday version of that.

what_camera_could_observe: Hands at every level of skill on the same kind of work
An apprentice's mistake, and how the master corrects it
Faces emerging from wood, then paint
what_must_be_real: The workshop, the apprentices and the commission must be real. Nothing is taught for the camera's benefit.

possible_arc.turn: An apprentice is given something beyond them.
possible_arc.ending_open: The commission leaves. What the master says about their own learning ends the film.

requirements: A working mask-carving workshop that trains apprentices
A real commission in progress during filming
Consent from the master and each apprentice

suggestions.name: Ambalangoda
suggestions.why: The best-known centre of traditional mask carving in Sri Lanka, with family workshops.
suggestions.access_notes: Some workshops are tourist-facing; a working, teaching one is needed
suggestions.verify: Confirm a workshop that still trains apprentices.

risks: Implying craft mastery equals spiritual attainment
drop_if: No workshop is training apprentices during the filming window

connections.note: A master reading apprentices here; a meditation teacher reading a newcomer there.
Both are craft films about looking closely; choose one to avoid two workshop films in the group.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
